text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Building condition, studying race 
tactics. The culmination of all of it is—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"This, too, is the beauty of meticulous 
planning. ...Ah, by the way—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Eating this katsudon is all part of the 
plan.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's high in protein and energy, 
making it a decent choice for post-workout 
nutrition. And above all—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Katsudon after a victory tastes especially 
delicious, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there's a 'Victory Don' for you 
too, Trainer. ...You're probably getting 
hungry right about now, right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
As the two of us looked back on today's 
race—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Let us savor the taste of victory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
All kinds of victory meals... Hehe, I see. 
Now that you mention it, that's very true.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will continue to run for a long time to 
come, stacking up victory after victory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we need to make sure we don't 
get tired of the victory meals. Which 
means—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let's go ask Turbo and the others about a 
new victory meal.
